title: Packers and Packagers, Hand
description: Pack or package by hand a wide variety of products and materials.

tasks.text: Examine and inspect containers, materials, or products to ensure that product quality and packing specifications are met.
Measure, weigh, and count products and materials.
Mark and label containers, container tags, or products, using marking tools.
Obtain, move, and sort products, materials, containers, and orders, using hand tools.
Remove completed or defective products or materials, placing them on moving equipment, such as conveyors, or in specified areas, such as loading docks.
Record product, packaging, and order information on specified forms and records.
Seal containers or materials, using glues, fasteners, nails, and hand tools.
Assemble, line, and pad cartons, crates, and containers, using hand tools.
Place or pour products or materials into containers, using hand tools and equipment, or fill containers from spouts or chutes.
Load materials and products into package processing equipment.
Clean containers, materials, supplies, or work areas, using cleaning solutions and hand tools.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Computer aided design CAD software
skills.def: Software to design 2D or 3D objects. May include engineering or architectural features. Examples: Autodesk AutoCAD.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Enterprise resource planning ERP software
skills.def: Software to integrate, monitor, or analyze data from multiple business operations within a unified system. Examples: SAP software.

skills.name: Inventory management software
skills.def: Software to maintain the inventory of businesses including restaurants or retail shops. Examples: Inventory tracking software.
